SGP.summary: Singapore has established a comprehensive regulatory framework for digital payment tokens and tokenization activities. The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) regulates digital payment token services under the Payment Services Act 2019 and has issued guidelines for tokenization of assets including securities and real estate.

regulations.title: Payment Services Act 2019
regulations.description: Establishes the regulatory framework for digital payment token (DPT) service providers. DPT service providers must obtain a license from MAS and comply with AML/CFT requirements.

regulations.title: MAS Guidelines on Provision of Digital Payment Token Services
regulations.description: Provides guidance on the regulatory requirements for DPT service providers, including custody, security, and consumer protection measures.

regulations.title: Project Guardian - Asset Tokenization
regulations.description: Industry pilot exploring applications of asset tokenization and DeFi in wholesale funding markets. Focuses on tokenization of bonds, deposits, and foreign exchange.

regulations.title: Variable Capital Companies (VCC) Framework
regulations.description: Enables fund managers to tokenize fund units and establish digital asset funds in Singapore.

USA.summary: The United States has a complex regulatory landscape for tokenization with multiple regulators involved. The SEC regulates security tokens, the CFTC oversees commodity tokens, and various banking regulators are developing frameworks for tokenized deposits and assets.
keyRegulators: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC)

regulations.title: SEC Framework for Investment Contract Analysis of Digital Assets
regulations.description: Provides guidance on when a digital asset is considered a security and subject to federal securities laws.

regulations.title: Regulation A+ for Security Token Offerings
regulations.description: Allows companies to offer and sell securities (including tokenized securities) with reduced regulatory requirements compared to traditional IPOs.

CHE.summary: Switzerland has established itself as a crypto-friendly jurisdiction with clear regulations for tokenization. The DLT Act provides legal certainty for tokenized assets and enables the creation of DLT securities.

regulations.title: DLT Act (Federal Act on the Adaptation of Federal Law to Developments in Distributed Ledger Technology)
regulations.description: Establishes the legal framework for tokenized securities (DLT securities) and enables their trading and custody.

regulations.title: FINMA ICO Guidelines
regulations.description: Provides guidance on the regulatory treatment of initial coin offerings and token classifications.
